newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: BIDS FOR ZAMBIA'S ZCCM TO OPEN FEB 28, 1997.
newsitem.headline: BIDS FOR ZAMBIA'S ZCCM TO OPEN FEB 28, 1997.

text.p: The Zambia Privatisation Agency (ZIPA) said on Wednesday bidding for Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines Ltd's assets up for sale will start on February 28, 1997.

"The privatisation agency will start advertising the assets, locally and internationally, next week for six months and bidding is expected to start on February 28, 1997," the agency head Valentine Chitalu told reporters.
Chitalu said negotiations on the acquisition of the assets with successful bidders were expected to start in the third quarter of 1997.
The Zambian government intends to sell ZCCM's assets in four tranches, with the Konkola mine and concentrator, and the Mfulira mine, concentrator, smelter and refinery forming one package.
The Nchanga mines, tailings leach plant and concentrator, the Nkana mines, concentrator, smelter and cobalt plant would make up a second package.
The Baluba and Luanshya mines and concentrator, the decommissioned Luanshya smelter, Ndola refinery and the Chambishi cobalt plant would make up a third package.
ZCCM's electricity transmission, distribution and generation assets would make a fourth package.
The Zambian government is already negotiating with a consortium led by Anglo American Corp of South Africa Ltd on the acquisition of the Konkola mine package.
Anglo, as minority shareholders in ZCCM, have pre-emptive rights in the purchase of its assets.
